Hi Jordan — quick answers below, happy to jump on the sizing call to go deeper. Short version first, then a bit more detail.

1) Hosted (shared) environment — noisy neighbor / isolation
- Short answer: we operate a combination of soft- and hard-isolation controls to protect tail latency: request-level QoS, adaptive batching, and per-tenant token limits. For most customers with p95 targets in the 50–200ms range, Hosted performs well. However, Hosted does not come with a dedicated throughput SLA.
- Details: We use request prioritization and continuous batching that adapts to workload shapes; we also apply dynamic admission control when a tenant exceeds burst thresholds so other tenants' p95s remain bounded. For customers with strict p95 SLOs tied to revenue, we typically recommend Dedicated.

2) Dedicated capacity — provisioning and autoscale
- Provisioning: Typical lead time for Reserved Dedicated pools is 2–4 business days (stock permitting); for larger commitments or private provisioning we coordinate capacity planning (1–3 weeks).
- Autoscale & bursting: Dedicated pools support autoscaling policies and can be configured with burst capacity tied to reserved headroom or pay-as-you-go bursts. For your traffic pattern (200 steady, 800 peak), we can size a pool with headroom for spikes and enable short-term burst capacity to avoid throttling.

3) Private VPC / on-prem — performance and ops
- Private VPC provides network isolation and customer-managed networking; performance is equivalent to Dedicated when matched on hardware. On-prem packages are available for regulated data, but they require coordination for installation, networking, and monitoring (typical timeline 3–6 weeks depending on site readiness).

4) SLAs & credits
- Hosted: best-effort latency; uptime SLA available for paid tiers but no per-tenant latency credit.
- Dedicated: SLA-backed uptime and latency targets are available under Reserved contracts; credits are typically defined in the contract (we'll share standard SLA language).

Attachments: I've attached the Dedicated overview and a SOC2 evidence stub for your security team. I'll also upload a short one-page SLA summary to the deal folder and share the link.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sizing call (Vivek + Priyom + Marissa) to confirm p95 targets, token size, and peak traffic windows so we can recommend Dedicated sizing and an estimated monthly cost. Are you available Wed 2/25 10:00–10:30am PT or Thu 2/26 2:00–2:30pm PT?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
